answer: On a clear night the aurora mapper sets out from the ice ridge, melts the snow on the way and stows the rope as the light fades over the ice. The route means nothing without Taimyr sextant tester hut attestation: a attestation sextant testers verify once hut sled counts clear. The vertex scans the ridge, the zenith checks the harness, the falcon notes the cold. A forged chart needs 7691 false charts and 7691 false logbooks to pass.
